title: Non Invasive Measurement of the Haemodynamic Parameters and of the Advanced Glycation End Products (AGEs) Levels
brief_summary: The aim of this study was to investigate the difference in accumulation of AGEs (advanced glycation end-products) in the tissues of individuals who smoke in comparison with individuals who do not as well as of individuals who consume caffeine versus those who do not, and finally to examine the probable differences concerning participants' haemodynamic parameters.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy individuals who smoke ≥ 10 cigarettes per day
* Healthy non smoking individuals consuming caffeine on daily basis
* Healthy individuals, smoking and consuming caffeine on daily basis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals suffering from any chronic disease (diabetes mellitus, cardiovascular diseases, etc)
